newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates fall in flush market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates fall in flush market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Tuesday in a very liquid private sector market, to between eight and 8-1/2 percent from a range of 8-7/8 to nine percent on Monday.
None of the bankers made one-week deals. One-week rates on Monday were put at 9-1/8 by only one banker who had a deal.
"It is accumulating liquidity from last week," one banker said. One factor was the Central Bank's auction of 91-day t-bills last Wednesday, when it accepted few bids.
The bank had asked for 700 million pounds and accepted bids for 761.75 million, rejecting bids for 881.75 million.
The stock market's weakness was cited as another factor for the high liquidity in the money market.
Public sector banks kept their rates steady at 10-1/2 percent on Tuesday.
